name: Ratio Above Truth
description: Proportion of forecast samples exceeding the observed value (0.5 = unbiased)

name: CRPS
description: Continuous Ranked Probability Score - measures calibration and sharpness

name: CRPS (log1p)
description: CRPS computed on log(1+x)-transformed forecasts and observations

name: CRPS Normalized
description: Normalized CRPS - CRPS divided by the range of observed values

name: Example Absolute Error
description: Sum of absolute error - demonstration metric

name: MAE
description: Mean Absolute Error - measures average absolute prediction error

name: MAPE
description: Mean Absolute Percentage Error - measures average absolute prediction error

name: Sensitivity
description: True positive rate for outbreak detection alerts

name: Specificity
description: True negative rate for outbreak detection alerts

name: Outbreak Accuracy
description: Proportion of correctly classified outbreak/non-outbreak periods

name: RMSE
description: Root Mean Squared Error - measures average prediction error magnitude

name: Sample Count
description: Number of forecast samples (sum across aggregation)

name: Winkler Score 10-90
description: Winkler score for 10th-90th percentile prediction interval

name: Winkler Score 25-75
description: Winkler score for 25th-75th percentile prediction interval

name: Winkler 10-90 (log1p)
description: Winkler score on log(1+x)-transformed values for 10-90 interval

name: Winkler 25-75 (log1p)
description: Winkler score on log(1+x)-transformed values for 25-75 interval
